findings.summary: The free-shipping check compares a cents subtotal to a threshold in whole dollars (50), so any cart over $0.50 ships free and the $7.99 flat rate is almost never charged.

judge.reason: Describes the same cents-vs-dollars threshold mismatch causing nearly all orders to ship free.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The tests miss the threshold bug because the only non-empty case is a $120 cart, which ships free either way. There are no cases below or exactly at the threshold.

judge.reason: This is a test coverage complaint, not a defect in the changed code, and has no candidate bug.

findings.label: false_alarm
